# Etieno Douglas

> Marketing and creative leader based in Nigeria, working remotely worldwide. Runs Aphinity Digital, an AI-centric digital marketing agency; Creative Lead at Chloe Consulting, a HubSpot partner agency; founder of The Crucible, a youth development and leadership community.

This portfolio has two sides: Creative & Marketing (brands, websites, products and marketing) and Leadership & Impact (youth empowerment, mentorship, speaking and partnerships).

## Creative & Marketing

- Marketing strategy & growth: creative and content strategy tying brand, story and channel into one plan, with SEO and visibility in AI answer engines (GEO). HubSpot-certified in content marketing.
- Brand & identity: identity systems, messaging and campaigns that stay consistent across every touchpoint.
- Web design & development: websites built on HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress or custom code.
- Products & platforms: booking systems, learning platforms and apps, with the dashboards that run them.
- [Aphinity Digital](https://aphinity.digital): his AI-centric, full-service digital marketing agency (branding, SEO, GEO, web, social, billboards, events).

## Selected projects

- [Splari Academy](https://splari.com/): Learning platform. A course marketplace where you buy a course once and a working practitioner assesses your final project.
- [Ace Trail Express](https://acetrail.vercel.app/): Booking & operations platform. Seat booking and a full operations system for a Toyota Sequoia shuttle between Uyo, Port Harcourt and Calabar.
- [Tell (Selah)](https://etienodouglas.online/#/work/tell): Mobile & desktop app. Notes that listen. Record a sermon, talk, class or meeting, and get organised notes, summaries and verified scripture.
- [Aphinity Invoicing](https://aphinity-app.vercel.app/): SaaS tool. Invoices for freelancers: polished templates recoloured to your brand, sent by email or WhatsApp.
- [Quinema](https://quinema-app.vercel.app/): Streaming app. A streaming app for movies and games: Nollywood, classics, comedy, horror and more, with lists and chat.
- [Eco Dash](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PelzStudioLabs.EcoDash): Mobile game · Android. An endless runner where you dash through polluted streets, collect trash and learn climate facts along the way.
- [Hispren](https://hispren.vercel.app/): Agency website. Church media and digital solutions: one sermon turned into videos, podcasts, books, blogs and social content.
- [New Frontiers Ministers' Global Network](https://newfrontiers.vercel.app/): Ministry network. A global network raising spiritually grounded, mentally robust and technologically empowered ministers.
- [Love Unites International](https://loveunitesinternational.org/): Nonprofit website. A humanitarian nonprofit empowering people through enterprise development and aid for underserved communities.
- [Paul Udah](https://thepauludah.vercel.app/): Personal brand site. The personal site of a leadership educator, speaker and author raising balanced, principled leaders.
- [Almanac](https://almanac-site-two.vercel.app/): B2B website. A maintained library of regulatory policies and procedures for UK charities, mapped to Charity Commission guidance.
- [D-Vine Consults](https://dvine-woad.vercel.app/): Architecture firm website. A Nigerian architectural firm with over 15 years of practice in interiors, sustainable design and engineering.
- [Architech](https://architech-site.vercel.app/): Architecture studio site. A showcase site for a residential and cultural architecture studio, from concept to completed home.
- [Owambe Fashion](https://owambefashion.com/): Fashion brand website. WordPress website design and development for a fashion brand, plus a landing page for its dress-up game.

## Leadership & Impact

- [The Crucible](https://crucible.etienodouglas.online/): founder. A growth community for young people focused on self-building, leadership and impact.
- [Love Unites International](https://loveunitesinternational.org/): partner. A humanitarian nonprofit empowering people through enterprise development and aid for underserved communities.
- Available for speaking (leadership, purpose, building in the digital age), youth programme partnerships and mentorship.
